title: A GUN CARRIED OUT KEEPS ITS SLOT
why: From the review of the four-gun belt, build 4. Decision D3 makes the guns on keys 1 and 2 gun 1 and gun 2 at home. When key 2 showed no gun (he had moved gun 2 to key 3, or put a Medkit on key 2) and the better gun was gun 2, D3 put the gun from key 1 back in gun 1 and left gun 2 empty: he came home with one gun and Bare Hands, the other gun he carried out sat in the armoury in no slot, the extraction deleted his key for it, and his next raid went up without it. The gun D3 moves out of gun 1 now takes gun 2 when gun 2 is empty, as long as he carried it out.
now: After an extraction a gun he carried out is never left in no slot, even when key 2 showed no gun.
